mapper.sql:
SELECT b.id, b.user_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url, b.title, b.content, b.images, b.likes, b.created_at,
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM blog_likes bl WHERE bl.blog_id = b.id AND bl.user_id = #{viewerId}) AS liked_by_me
FALSE AS liked_by_me
FROM travel_blogs b JOIN users u ON u.id = b.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_blogs (user_id, title, content, images) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{images, typeHandler=com.travelgd.handler.JsonListStringHandler})
mapper.update: UPDATE travel_blogs SET likes = likes + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM travel_blogs WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO blog_likes (user_id, blog_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{blogId})
